create_Sensor_instance: create a Sensor instance with custom width, height, and config path for tactile rendering
add_camera_to_Sensor: add a camera to the Sensor by providing obj_id and link_ids for tactile observation
add_object_to_Sensor: add an object URDF to the Sensor scene with global scaling for rendering
render_tacto_images: render tactile color and depth images from each camera view using Sensor.render()
get_contact_force: get accumulated normal contact forces for a camera using Sensor.get_force(cam_name)
